articles.company_name: Algoma Steel Group Inc. Common Shares
articles.summary: SAULT STE. MARIE, Ontario, Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Algoma Steel Group Inc. (NASDAQ: ASTL; TSX: ASTL) (“Algoma” or “the Company”), a leading Canadian producer of steel plate and hot rolled sheet products, today provided guidance for its quarter ended September 30, 2026.
articles.title: Algoma Steel Group Inc. Provides Guidance for the Third Quarter 2026
